title: harness: discarding a check result is a must-use error
purpose: A check whose successor result is dropped cannot silently disappear.

failure.justification: spec 11.9: statically visible successor loss is a semantic error; runtime discard checks remain defensive. Either stage is conforming; the program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.9 / static successor consumption: `c.same_int(...)` as a discarded statement loses a successor.
